admission.justification: The honest-entry family must count status-only successor revisions as revision changes, rather than hiding them as relationship-only changes merely because their wording is equal.

applicability: A successor head revision of an invariant or family in the after snapshot of a leaf review comparison.
conditions: The two selected head revisions differ and the authored statement or guarantee and relationships are equal.
exclusions: A successor that changes only realizations or members is counted as a relationship-only change.
A state or writer display difference alone does not create a new revision.
statement: An invariant or family successor with unchanged statement or guarantee and unchanged relationships contributes one revision to each side of the changed-intent count.
